test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The position of how many letters will be changed if each of the letters in the word JOURNEY is arranged in alphabetical order?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fc278fe789af8222fe6cac882237358a9d0a2182b555ce3565db4085f8b1202.png] 

Given word: 'JOURNEY'

After arranging in alphabetical order:

 
 

 Alphabets
 J
 O
 U
 R
 N
 E
 Y
 
 

 Alphabetical order
 E
 J
 N
 O
 R
 U
 Y
 
 

From the above table, the positions of J, O, U, R, N, and E are changed

 
 

 Alphabets
 J
 O
 U
 R
 N
 E
 
 

 Alphabetical order
 E
 J
 N
 O
 R
 U
 
 

Thus, there are 6 letters in the word whose positions are changed.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4". **
